title.zh: 在拉乌尼翁省设立区域国立农业学校，名称为拉乌尼翁区域农业学校，并授权为此拨付所需经费的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a Regional National Agricultural School in the Province of La Union to be Known as the La Union Regional Agricultural School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Necessary Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish a Regional National Agricultural School in the Province of La Union to be Known as the La Union Regional Agricultural School, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Necessary Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Nông nghiệp Vùng Quốc gia tại Tỉnh La Union với tên gọi Trường Nông nghiệp La Union Vùng, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนเกษตรกรรมภูมิภาคแห่งชาติในจังหวัด La Union ในชื่อโรงเรียนเกษตรกรรม La Union ภูมิภาค และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Pertanian Regional Nasional di Provinsi La Union dengan nama Sekolah Pertanian La Union Regional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Pertanian Wilayah Kebangsaan di Wilayah La Union dengan nama Sekolah Pertanian La Union Wilayah, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Public Schools and to be headed by a superintendent, a regional national agricultural school to be known as the La Union Regional Agricultural School, within the Province of La Union.

The Director of Public Schools is hereby empowered to locate and acquire, or cause to be located or acquired, a suitable site for the purpose of this Act which shall be a private or public land situated in the Province of La Union.

The sum of three hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school for the school year nineteen hundred sixty to nineteen hundred sixty-one. Thereafter the necessary sum for said purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960
